messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Latency SLO breach p99 3.1s for /v1/stream in eu-west-2. Auto-page: @ben_oncall. Signs: streaming stalls and elevated retry counts on router layer.

ben_oncall: on it. Seeing p95 ~ 480ms, p99 ~ 3.1s. Alert spike started ~12m ago. Any scheduled rollouts? :thinking:

nina_sre: no platform deploys in last 60m. Telemetry: router -> edge-lb retry rate up 6x, connection queue depth high on edge-lb-euw2-*. Heatmap shows traffic concentrated on backend shard 7.

reza_infra: checking load distribution. There's a routing-policy rollout annotated at 16:20 UTC that adjusted locality weights (prefer-zone). It looks like rounding in the new weight calc can push a tiny delta into a large effective weight bucket for some routers.

liam_router: I shipped prefer-zone rollout 30m ago but with a newer binning function. Rolling that config back now. Patch: revert commit 7b8e9f. Flipping config in 4 zones.

emma_prod: product impact: a couple EU customers reported long streaming pauses. Are we losing responses or just delay? Support triage?

tina_support: customers say streams pause and then resume; no truncated responses reported. Sending holding message once we have rollback status.

deploy-bot: revert 7b8e9f initiated by liam_router at 1765432192. 2/6 routers reverted.

nina_sre: I recommend two quick mitigations in parallel: 1) eject the overloaded backend instances from LB pool (soft-drain so existing streams finish), 2) set router fallback to round-robin (disable sticky affinity) to spread load.

reza_infra: kicking ejection for backend-shard-7 now: aws autoscaler -> drain target group. Also disabling stickiness on lb-proxy-euw2.

ben_oncall: executing firewall rule to temporarily reduce retry amplification: limit retries from router to 1 for euw2 for 10 minutes.

liam_router: rollback completed at 1765432208 across all routers. Also toggled prefer-zone=false via feature-flag kill-switch.

nina_sre: immediate effect: p99 dropped from 3.1s -> 1.4s within ~30s of rollback. p95 now ~360ms. Some long-lived streams still show stalls (they were mid-flight on overloaded backends).

tina_support: posted initial customer message: "Investigating increased streaming latency in EU-West-2. Engineers are actively mitigating; no data loss observed. We'll update in 15 minutes." Sent at 1765432215.

emma_prod: good. Draft follow-up: explain cause is routing weight skew due to policy calc; mention mitigation steps and offer customers a route to dedicated capacity if they need immediate stability.

liam_router: root-cause hypothesis: new binning/rounding in weight calc mapped tiny differences into adjacent bucket causing >2x traffic to some hosts. Repro on staging with stress harness. PR to fix ready: branch fix/weight-bucket-clamp, includes unit tests and regression for tiny-delta case.

nina_sre: additional guard: added a soft cap on per-host qps in router (2000 req/s) to prevent single-host blowups until proper fix lands. Also created a short-term alert for shard skew > 2.5x.

ben_oncall: nice. Let's keep ejections until queue depth < 10 and p99 < 1.5s for 10m. Schedule live handoff in 20m for follow-up.

reza_infra: metric snapshot (pre-mitigation vs now): pre: p99=3.1s p95=480ms errors 0.9% retries 6x; now: p99=1.4s p95=360ms errors 0.15% retries 1.2x. Recording graphs -> ops runbook.

tina_support: customers updated at 1765432230. One enterprise asked for postmortem ETA; I offered an ITRack ticket and priority follow-up.

liam_router: will merge fix after a tight canary in staging + unit tests. Plan to deploy tomorrow with stricter telemetry and an immediate kill-switch.

ben_oncall: good. Please file an incident report and link here. Keep thread open until steady-state for 20m. If p99 > 1.6s re-escalate to eng-platform.

incident-bot: Incident transitioned -> mitigated. Pager cleared. Actions: rollback applied, backend ejection, retry cap, stickiness disabled. Please attach postmortem: owner liam_router.
